title: Valkey (NetBox cache and queue)
description: The Valkey trio behind NetBox: primary and Sentinel agreement, replication, load, NetBox's RQ task queue, memory and persistence.

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: The Valkey that takes writes. NetBox finds it by asking the Sentinels (REDIS_SENTINELS).

defaults.noValue: NO PRIMARY

panels.title: Sentinels say
panels.description: The primary address each Sentinel reports; more than one name here means they disagree.

defaults.noValue: no Sentinel data

panels.title: Checks
panels.description: One primary with both replicas linked, the three Sentinels agreeing on it with quorum (2), memory under 80 % of maxmemory (512 MB, policy noeviction: at 100 % writes fail and NetBox's jobs stop), persistence (appendonly) working.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Failovers in range
panels.description: Sentinel's config epoch rises by one per failover.

panels.title: Memory (primary)
panels.description: used_memory against maxmemory (512 MB).

panels.title: NetBox clients
panels.description: Clients of the primary (NetBox web and worker on netbox01/02, the replicas, the exporter). RQ workers wait for jobs in a blocking pop, so 'blocked' is the number of idle workers.

panels.title: Keys
panels.description: db0: NetBox's task queue (RQ jobs, workers, registries); db1: its cache.

panels.title: RQ jobs queued
panels.description: Jobs waiting in NetBox's RQ queues (high, default, low). A growing number means netbox-worker is down or stuck.

targets.expr: sum(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key=~"rq:queue:.*"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})) or max(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key="rq:workers"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})) * 0

defaults.noValue: Needs redis_exporter --check-keys for NetBox's RQ keys (REDIS_EXPORTER_CHECK_KEYS=db0=rq:queue:*,db0=rq:failed:*,db0=rq:workers)

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Behind: replication offset bytes the replica hasn't received yet. Link: the replica's link to the primary (empty on the primary). Sentinel: that VM's Sentinel answers its exporter.

targets.expr: max by (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}) * 2 or max by (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="slave"})
max by (host) (scalar(max(redis_master_repl_offset{job="valkey"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}))) - redis_slave_repl_offset{job="valkey"})

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

targets.expr: max by (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}) * 2 or max by (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="slave"}) or max by (host) (redis_up{job="valkey"} == 0)

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Sentinel events
panels.description: +sdown/+odown (a node unreachable), +try-failover/+elected-leader/+promoted-slave (a failover) and +switch-master (the new primary) from the Sentinels' logs.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: What each Sentinel sees
panels.description: Healthy: every Sentinel sees 3 Sentinels (itself included) and 2 replicas.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey-sentinel job yet

panels.title: Full and partial resyncs
panels.description: Per hour, counted on the primary. A full resync copies the whole dataset (after a failover or a long outage); partial ones only the backlog.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Commands per second (primary)
panels.description: NetBox's commands (the exporters' own INFO/CONFIG/LATENCY/AUTH... left out): RQ uses lists, sorted sets and hashes (lpush, blmove, zadd, hset, exec...), the cache get/set.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (cmd) (rate(redis_commands_total{job="valkey", cmd!~"info|latency.*|config.*|auth|ping|slowlog.*|client.*|select|dbsize|memory.*|cluster.*|hello|command.*"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})))

defaults.noValue: No commands from NetBox in range

panels.title: Latency p99 per command (primary)
panels.description: From Valkey's per-command latency histograms (LATENCY HISTOGRAM): time inside Valkey, not the network.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, cmd) (rate(redis_commands_latencies_usec_bucket{job="valkey", cmd!~"info|latency.*|config.*|auth|ping|slowlog.*|client.*|select|dbsize|memory.*|cluster.*|hello|command.*"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}))))

defaults.noValue: No commands from NetBox in range

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Lookups that found their key: NetBox's cache (db1) and RQ's polling (db0) together.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet
No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Connections and errors
panels.description: Error replies by type (errorstats): NOAUTH/WRONGPASS mean a client with the wrong password.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Jobs queued
panels.description: Waiting jobs per queue (NetBox: high, default, low).

targets.expr: max by (key) (redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key=~"rq:queue:.*"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}))

sum(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key=~"rq:queue:.*"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})) or max(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key="rq:workers"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"})) * 0

defaults.noValue: Needs redis_exporter --check-keys for NetBox's RQ keys (REDIS_EXPORTER_CHECK_KEYS=db0=rq:queue:*,db0=rq:failed:*,db0=rq:workers)

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: RQ's failed job registry per queue (kept for result_ttl). NetBox shows them under Admin > Background Tasks.

targets.expr: max by (key) (redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key=~"rq:failed:.*"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}))

defaults.noValue: Needs redis_exporter --check-keys for NetBox's RQ keys (REDIS_EXPORTER_CHECK_KEYS=db0=rq:queue:*,db0=rq:failed:*,db0=rq:workers)

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: netbox-worker processes registered with RQ (one per NetBox VM) and how many wait for work.

targets.expr: max(redis_key_size{job="valkey", db="db0", key="rq:workers"} and on (host) (redis_instance_info{job="valkey", role="master"}))

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet
No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Expired / evicted keys
panels.description: Eviction stays 0 with maxmemory-policy noeviction; writes fail instead.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: AOF
panels.description: appendonly yes: the task queue survives a restart. The AOF is rewritten (compacted) when it doubles.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Fragmentation
panels.description: RSS / used. High values on a small dataset are normal (allocator overhead).

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet

panels.title: Since last RDB save
panels.description: Valkey also snapshots on its default save rules; replicas get one per full resync.

defaults.noValue: No data from the valkey job (redis_exporter, services-config valkey-monitoring.tf) yet
No node_exporter on the Valkey VMs yet
No node_exporter on the Valkey VMs yet

panels.title: Root FS used
panels.description: The AOF and RDB live in /var/lib/valkey.

targets.expr: 1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", role="valkey", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", role="valkey", mountpoint="/"}

defaults.noValue: No node_exporter on the Valkey VMs yet

panels.title: Valkey and Sentinel log
panels.description: valkey-server and valkey-sentinel from the journal (Alloy to Loki).
